My Gallery

JavaScript, Processing, Ceramics and 3D Models

Flow Field

4,000 particles follow an invisible field of angles, leaving pink and green trails. JavaScript, HTML Canvas.

Pixel Fan Flyer

A pixel-art fan flutters across a scrolling sky with drifting clouds. Click or tap the sky to call it over. JavaScript, HTML Canvas.

Drifting Bubbles

Translucent circles orbit gently over a pink-to-mint gradient. JavaScript, HTML Canvas.

Sandbox

Layered translucent ellipses blend from red to blue into a soft gradient. Processing, ported to JavaScript.

Text

The word “Create” drifts across the canvas and bounces off the edges. Processing, ported to JavaScript.

Square Rotate

Fifteen lime cubes turn in 3D, each slightly offset, unfolding into a rotating spiral. Processing, ported to p5.js.

Random Walk Lines

A trail of lines wanders randomly in shifting colors over a new background each visit. p5.js, TypeScript.

Pic Brain

A blue-and-yellow brain image stretches and warps as its corners drift apart. Click to snap it back and start a new warp. Processing, ported to p5.js.

Triad

Three gradient orbs in orange, red and yellow orbit 120° apart, drifting and bobbing with Perlin noise. Processing, ported to JavaScript.

Lighting

Five hundred points jitter along a random walk like a jagged bolt, flashing a new color twice a second. Processing, ported to JavaScript.

Peach

A thin triangle sweeps around the center like a clock hand, leaving peach-pink lines that build up into a disc. Processing, ported to JavaScript.

Build

Random rectangles, ellipses and lines pile up four times a second in translucent colors, layering into a busy collage. Processing, ported to JavaScript.

Symmetry

One hundred twenty outlined squares, placed around an arc, rotate together to form shifting symmetrical patterns in soft mint. Processing, ported to JavaScript.

Burst

Hundreds of gray and white rays of random length flicker outward from the center five times a second, like a starburst on teal. Processing, ported to JavaScript.

Mouse Worm

Move the mouse to paint a trail of golden rings that piles up into a worm, with a fan of thin lines stretching back to fixed points. Processing, ported to JavaScript.

Mandala

Thirty layers of navy quads, rust triangles and pale outlined squares rotate in steps around the center, unfolding into a turning mandala. Processing, ported to JavaScript.

Tennis

A blue court where a stretchy yellow ball, a random net line and a curving black paddle jump to new spots seven times a second. Processing, ported to JavaScript.

Weather

Gray clouds drift across a midnight sky while 300 bright blue raindrops fall and loop back to the top. Processing, ported to JavaScript.
